title: Budapest and the Country: The 'Water-Head' Debate
grammar: Approximative spatial postpositions: táján and tájékán ('around / in the vicinity of')
goal: I can articulate arguments concerning the disproportionate demographic and economic weight of Budapest (vízfejűség).
I can use táján and tájékán to express spatial approximation and regional vicinity.
I can debate centralization, regional development, and commuter catchment areas using formal Hungarian.
